fields.name: excerpt
fields.title: Excerpt
fields.description: One or two sentences shown on the index page

fields.title: Reading Time in Minutes
fields.description: Leave blank and the site calculates it from the article length. Only fill this in to override.

fields.name: tldr
fields.title: TL;DR
fields.description: The whole report in two or three sentences, for readers who want the conclusion before deciding to read on. Shown in a highlighted box directly under the headline.

fields.name: keyTakeaways
fields.title: Key Takeaways
fields.description: Three to five scannable bullet points. These appear in a summary panel above the article and are what most readers will actually absorb.

fields.name: content
fields.title: Content
fields.description: Use "Section heading (H2)" for each major section — the website builds the table of contents from these automatically.

fields.name: furtherReading
fields.title: Further Reading
fields.description: Extra sources listed at the foot of the report. Anything cited inline while writing is added to Sources automatically — this is only for material not cited directly.

fields.name: slug

fields.description: The unique URL for this property

fields.name: listingType

fields.description: Which section of the site this listing belongs to. Buy = new and active listings. Sell = owner resale units. Stay = luxury short stays.

fields.name: developer

fields.description: The developer partner behind this project

fields.description: The partner wall sits on a dark background. "White" turns every logo into a clean white mark so dark logos stay visible and the wall looks consistent. Choose "Original colours" for a logo that is already light, or "On a white tile" to keep a dark, full-colour logo exactly as supplied. A logo with a solid background (for example a JPG) should use "On a white tile".

fields.description: A direct link to an .mp4 or .webm file (for example a Cloudinary video URL). Cloudinary links are served at best quality automatically. Page links from Google Drive, YouTube or Vimeo are not video files and play at reduced quality or not at all.

fields.title: Video File
fields.description: Upload the original export, not a copy sent through WhatsApp, email or a phone share sheet (those are recompressed). Best results: MP4 (H.264), 1920×1080 or 2560×1440, 8 to 15 Mbps, 10 to 30 seconds, no audio needed. iPhone .mov files are often HEVC and will not play in Chrome or on Android; export them as MP4 first.
